text.en: Accept supreme command

text.fr: Tu acceptes que ton nom réponde désormais de toute la chaîne Marine.
text.en: You accept that your name now answers for the entire Marine chain.

text.fr: À trente-trois ans, ton dossier arrive devant le conseil supérieur : promotions, refus, rapports et crises tiennent sur plusieurs piles. On te demande enfin ce que ton service doit laisser derrière lui.
text.en: At thirty-three, your file reaches the senior council: promotions, refusals, reports, and crises fill several stacks. You are finally asked what your service should leave behind.

text.fr: Laisser une chaîne fiable
text.en: Leave a reliable chain

text.fr: Ton héritage devient une chaîne que l'on peut suivre et contrôler.
text.en: Your legacy becomes a chain people can follow and check.

text.fr: Laisser des protections durables
text.en: Leave durable protections

text.fr: Ton héritage fixe des protections qui survivent aux circonstances.
text.en: Your legacy sets protections that survive circumstances.

text.fr: Laisser des officiers autonomes
text.en: Leave autonomous officers

text.fr: Ton héritage donne de l'autonomie sans supprimer la responsabilité.
text.en: Your legacy gives autonomy without removing accountability.

notes: Layer 1 specialized entry is gated only by the ten real Family Marine handoff Outcomes that currently derive marine + marine_recruit.
Later specialized routes are History-derived from the immediately previous Major root; Dice failure deliberately falls back to the route-local safety node.
No persistent Saga state, flags, personal ship, personal crew, bounty effect, or post-opener career switch is introduced.

Scenario execution requires shared career_marine MajorTrack registration; the current Saga scenario runner also hardcodes careerPhase=childhood and therefore cannot execute Active scenarios until shared tooling supports Active phase.
